_comment: Every price field in this file: verify against provider pricing pages before use. USD per 1M tokens. 'cached' is the price of a cached input token (cache read). Provider blocks carry cache and batch terms; cache_write_multiplier is the 5-minute cache-write price as a multiple of input, cache_write_1h_multiplier the 1-hour one (default 2.0). A model missing here is reported as unpriced, never guessed. A provider block with cache_mode "implicit" caches prompts by itself, so the report recommends no prompt-caching action for its routes. 'class' (decision, small, mid, frontier) drives the other-provider candidates of --scope open; 'tier' drives same-provider routing. A model without 'tier' is never a same-provider routing target; a model without 'class' is never an open-scope candidate.

google._verify: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing (read 2026-11-12); cache and batch terms were not verified, so none are assumed
